name: Sarah Chowdhury
title: Aspiring Platform & Operations Engineer
about: I'm a Computer Science student at BRAC University (graduating Feb 2027), working toward platform engineering and operations.

I like systems that are reliable, checked and well documented. My thesis pipeline has controls and audits built in, and as a volunteer Track Lead I guide 21 scholars through Google Cloud certification prep.
AZ-900 certified · Google Cloud Computing Foundations completed.

projects.name: LLM-Based Semantic Augmentation in Multimodal Classification
points: Built and quality-checked a pipeline where a vision-language model describes game frames and dialogue to improve classification; led most of the engineering.
Compared prompting and fusion strategies on 1,600 items; adding descriptions raised macro-F1 from 0.505 to 0.630.
Checked quality with a shuffled-description control, model–human agreement (κ = 0.44) and label-leakage audits; found and fixed a calibration error in late fusion.
projects.summary: Measured how vision-language model descriptions improve a multimodal classifier: macro-F1 rose from 0.505 to 0.630.

projects.name: Question and Answer Text Classification
projects.summary: Prepared labeled text data and tuned neural and recurrent classifiers to 70% test accuracy.

welcome: Oh, a visitor! Welcome to my little potion shop.
I'm Sarah. I love mixing creativity with tech, so I turned my portfolio into a potion shop, inspired by my favourite game, Stardew Valley, and the magic in my favourite manga, Witch Hat Atelier.
Every bottle on these shelves is a skill or a topic I've worked with. Mix two in the cauldron to see what I made with them.
Some mixes hide secret recipes about me. And that's Luna, asleep on the shelf. She runs the place.

secrets.title: My favourite game
secrets.text: Stardew Valley, all the way. It's a big part of why I'm passionate about combining creativity and tech, and why this portfolio is a pixel potion shop.

secrets.title: On my bookshelf
secrets.text: Classic fiction and manga. My favourite manga of all time is Witch Hat Atelier, and its magic is where this witchy spell station came from.

secrets.title: My newest hobby
secrets.text: I recently picked up art: one more way to mix creativity with the things I build.

secrets.title: Where I'm heading
secrets.text: I want to work in platform engineering and operations: keeping systems reliable, automated and well documented, so other people can build with confidence.

secrets.title: What I care about
secrets.text: Whether it's a thesis pipeline or a scholar's slides, I like checking work carefully and giving feedback that is clear and kind.
